description: Works to Quercus Robur Oak Tree covered by TPO NO. 256 (1999) - (T1) crown reduction by up to 2m to nearest growth furniture.
decision_conditions: The branch length reduction shall be strictly limited to lateral branches on the east side of the crown only and shall not exceed a reduction greater than 2m. The height and the remainder of the crown shall not be pruned. The works shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.
This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
